text:
alex: Heads-up — after last night's console deploy I'm seeing non‑monotonic percentiles on the service breakdown. p50 sometimes lower than p25 for some endpoints :confused:

maria: hmm can you paste a permalink to the chart + time range?

alex: https://console.redwood.ai/d/latency/endpoint?from=now-1h&to=now — looks reproducible around 23:12 UTC. low-count endpoints mostly. screenshot attached (small sample counts).

devon: did we change any merging or smoothing code in the aggregation service in that deploy?

infra-bot: deploy #infra-2026-03-22-47 completed by @jen on branch release/aggregation-fix at 2026-03-22T23:05:12Z

alex: @devon not on the runtime, but the console now applies a decaying-window smoothing in the frontend for sparkline + pctl overlay (PR 4256). could that interplay with sampled rollups?

maria: low counts + post-aggregation smoothing could invert percentiles temporarily. but monotonicity should be enforced server-side at rollup time. we never relied on frontend to keep quantiles monotonic.

sam: quick check — here's the query we use for the endpoint pctl aggregate:```sql
SELECT endpoint, tdigest_combine(td), quantile(td, 0.25) AS p25, quantile(td, 0.5) AS p50, quantile(td, 0.95) AS p95 FROM rollups WHERE ts >= :start AND ts < :end GROUP BY endpoint;```

sam: if tdigest bins are tiny for single-sample buckets they can produce artifacts around interpolation. we should ensure quantile(td, x) uses monotonic interpolation or afterwards apply pctl = max(pctl, previous_pctl) across percentiles.

devon: I pushed a small experiment branch that post-processes the quantiles to enforce monotonicity in the query layer (clip p50 = max(p50, p25), p95 = max(p95, p50)). can triggerable?

maria: That mask would hide real regressions if p25 erroneously high. better to add a guard: if sample_count < 10 then mark as low-confidence and surface a badge instead of enforced clipping.

alex: Agreed. UX: show low-sample badge, and in the tooltip note that pctl smoothing was applied in frontend for visualization only, while server rollup is raw. Need clarity in the console so users don't assume monotonicity guarantees.

devon: Plan: (1) quick hotfix to console to add low-sample badge and disable decaying-window smoothing for pctl overlay for endpoints with sample_count < 50; (2) add a server-side monotonicity audit in nightly backfill for rollups; (3) add unit in query layer to surface low-confidence.

maria: +1. Also add a small regression test in e2e that checks monotonicity after joining rollups for a synthetic tdigest with adversarial values.

alex: I'll file a ticket and tag the rollback if we see customer-facing alerts. For now I'm going to run a backfill comparison between pre-deploy and post-deploy windows to quantify how many endpoints hit this artifact.

sam: If anyone wants to reproduce locally, run:```bash
# generate adversarial tdigest samples
python tools/gen_tdigest_artifact.py --endpoint epX --out /tmp/td.bin
# ingest into staging rollups
./bin/rollup_ingest --file /tmp/td.bin --ts 2026-03-22T23:10:00Z
```

devon: copying plan details to PR and will open a short-lived feature flag to flip smoothing off. ping me if you want to test the monotonic query change.

maria: thanks — this feels like a UX+telemetry boundary bug (frontend smoothing + low sample telemetry). good catch. :thumbsup:
